2608.05069.title: VQ-VAD: Vector-quantized Motion Representation Learning for Human-centric Video Anomaly Detection
2608.05069.paper_summary: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) is inherently challenging due to the scarcity of anomalies and the large visual variability in surveillance footage, including changes in lighting, viewpoint, and human appearance. To mitigate visual noise and address privacy concerns, recent work has shifted to pose-based VAD, which focuses on motion dynamics rather than raw video data. However, existing pose-based approaches model human behavior in continuous latent spaces, limiting their ability to learn compact motion patterns necessary for robust behavior analysis. We address this by proposing Vector-Quantized Video Anomaly Detection (VQ-VAD), a novel human-centric anomaly detection framework that learns discrete motion representations. VQ-VAD adapts Vector-Quantized GAN (VQ-GAN), originally developed for image generation, to operate on keypoint sequences and construct a motion codebook of normal behavior. Trained exclusively on normal motion sequences, VQ-VAD detects anomalies by identifying high reconstruction errors when an observed motion sequence cannot be mapped to the learned codebook. We conduct extensive experiments across three complementary evaluation settings, including in-domain, cross-domain, and cross-dataset generalization, on four anomaly detection benchmarks. VQ-VAD achieves strong in-domain accuracy (81.83% on HR-SHT [15]), effective cross-domain transfer from CMU Panoptic [14] (76.69% on HR-SHT [15] without retraining), and competitive cross-dataset robustness. The code base for this work is available at https://github.com/TeCSAR-UNCC/VQ-VAD.
2608.05069.paper_summary_zh: 視頻異常檢測（VAD）本質上具有挑戰性，因為異常事件稀少且監控影片中的視覺變化很大，包括光照、視角和人類外觀的變化。為了減少視覺噪音並解決隱私問題，最近的研究轉向基於姿勢的 VAD，專注於運動動態而非原始視頻數據。然而，現有的基於姿勢的方法在連續潛在空間中建模人類行為，限制了它們學習緊湊運動模式的能力，而這對於穩健的行為分析是必要的。我們通過提出向量量化視頻異常檢測（VQ-VAD）來解決這一問題，這是一種新穎的人本異常檢測框架，旨在學習離散運動表示。VQ-VAD 調整了原本為圖像生成開發的向量量化生成對抗網絡（VQ-GAN），使其能在關鍵點序列上運作並構建正常行為的運動代碼本。VQ-VAD 僅在正常運動序列上進行訓練，通過識別當觀察到的運動序列無法映射到學習的代碼本時出現的高重建誤差來檢測異常。我們在四個異常檢測基準上進行了廣泛的實驗，涵蓋三個互補的評估設置，包括領域內、跨領域和跨數據集的泛化。VQ-VAD 在領域內準確率上表現強勁（在 HR-SHT [15] 上達到 81.83%），有效地從 CMU Panoptic [14] 進行跨領域轉移（在 HR-SHT [15] 上達到 76.69% 並且無需重新訓練），並在跨數據集的穩健性方面具有競爭力。這項工作的代碼庫可在 https://github.com/TeCSAR-UNCC/VQ-VAD 獲得。
